mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_upload_tickets (ticket_id, user_id, object_key, expected_size, expected_format, expected_mime, status, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{userId}, #{objectKey}, #{expectedSize}, #{expectedFormat}, #{expectedMime}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ticket_id, user_id, object_key, expected_size, expected_format, expected_mime, status, expires_at, created_at, confirmed_at FROM image_upload_tickets WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId}
mapper.update: UPDATE image_upload_tickets SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'VERIFYING'
UPDATE image_upload_tickets SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ISSUED'
